column1: # CORRECTIONS APPLIED TO THE CORPUS, and who checked them. PLAN.md rule 1: every replacement is
# re-derived by an implementer (A), independently disproved-or-confirmed by a verifier (B), and
# recorded here. A row with no verifier is not a finished correction. `gate` is the numeric or
# textual test named in PLAN.md for that finding, and what it read after the change.
# Tab-separated. Rows are appended per sitting; the commit column is filled when the row lands.
